title: Implement performance page
description:
Create Source/GUI/PerformancePage.h and Source/GUI/PerformancePage.cpp implementing `class PerformancePage : public juce::Component`, the primary performance view.

Contents: the eight macro controls, the profile browser (juce::ComboBox listing available profiles plus load action), four scene buttons, global Mix, input level, output level, bypass, tap tempo, Hold, adaptive mode selector, the status indicators, and an owned MeterComponent instance.

Binding layering rule: macro controls talk to the MacroEngine only. A macro control must NEVER call `setValueNotifyingHost` on a coordinated destination parameter and must never rewrite base APVTS values for destinations. Only explicit profile recall may replace base APVTS values, and only on the message thread. Macro, scene, and adaptive contributions are deltas combined internally by the engine.

This page owns its own APVTS attachments (`juce::AudioProcessorValueTreeState::SliderAttachment`, `ButtonAttachment`, `ComboBoxAttachment`) held in `std::unique_ptr` members. Use the exact parameter ID strings declared in the parameter layout header — do not invent IDs.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/Parameters/ParameterLayout.h (authoritative parameter ID constants; use these verbatim)
- Source/Macro/MacroEngine.h (or the actual macro engine header present in Source/) for the macro set-value entry point
- Source/GUI/MeterComponent.h and Source/GUI/CustomLookAndFeel.h
- Source/PluginProcessor.h (accessors for the APVTS, the macro engine, and getTelemetryState)

Constructor signature should take the processor (or its APVTS plus engine references) by reference. Implement `resized()` with a proportional juce::FlexBox or Rectangle-based layout so the page works in a resizable editor. Do not register the files in CMakeLists.txt; j.8 owns that.
acceptance_criteria: Source/GUI/PerformancePage.h declares class PerformancePage deriving from juce::Component
Source/GUI/PerformancePage.cpp constructs eight macro controls, a profile browser combo box, four scene buttons, and controls for Mix, input, output, bypass, tap tempo, Hold, and adaptive mode
Source/GUI/PerformancePage.h holds APVTS attachments as std::unique_ptr members owned by the page
Every parameter ID string used in Source/GUI/PerformancePage.cpp matches an ID declared in Source/Parameters/ParameterLayout.h
No macro control callback in Source/GUI/PerformancePage.cpp calls setValueNotifyingHost on a coordinated destination parameter; macro changes route through the macro engine entry point
Source/GUI/PerformancePage.cpp owns a MeterComponent instance and implements resized() with a proportional layout
Source/GUI/PerformancePage.h and .cpp include no header from Source/DSP other than the processor header needed for parameter and engine access
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify Source/PluginProcessor.*, Source/PluginEditor.*, Source/Parameters/*, or any macro/scene engine file
modify Source/GUI/MeterComponent.*, Source/GUI/CustomLookAndFeel.*, or any other page file
call setValueNotifyingHost on coordinated destination parameters from macro controls
invent parameter ID strings not present in Source/Parameters/ParameterLayout.h
use any artist or song name

allowed: choose control layout, grouping, and label text
choose slider styles and rotary versus linear per control
forbidden: write destination parameters directly from macro controls
